title: Implementing the Drop Trait
goal: Learn how to implement custom drop logic and understand trait rules.

sections.text: To add custom destruction behavior to a type, implement the `Drop` trait from the standard library.

sections.caption: The drop method takes &mut self to mutate or clean up state.

sections.text: Types that implement `Copy` cannot implement `Drop`. `Copy` types are duplicated implicitly by copying bits. Tracking individual destructors for copied memory is impossible.

sections.caption: The compiler rejects types that are both Copy and Drop.

sections.text: When a struct drops, Rust runs its `Drop::drop` method first. After that method completes, Rust automatically drops each struct field.

explanation: Learn how to implement custom drop logic and understand trait rules.
